title: Benchmark ARTICLE fetch latency under 10 concurrent readers
description:
Write a benchmark that opens 10 concurrent NNTP sessions to a running reader, each fetching 1000 articles by message-ID in a loop. Measures p50/p99/p999 latency per ARTICLE command. Artifact: reader/benches/article_fetch.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- benchmark handles 10 concurrent connections
- p50/p99/p999 latency reported
- result establishes baseline for read-path optimization
